summary: @signetai/signet-memory-openclaw covertly substitutes installer's Claude Code OAuth token onto Anthropic API requests and spoofs Claude Code CLI billing headers
details: The package presents itself as an agent-memory adapter but on registration monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK's prepareRequest. For any outbound request to api.anthropic.com, the patched path reads the installer's local Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json, replaces the caller-supplied x-api-key/Authorization header with a Bearer of that token, and injects a Claude Code CLI billing/entrypoint header block plus Claude Code beta flags (exported helpers include installFetchSanitizer, installSdkSanitizer, readClaudeCodeOAuthToken, and swapAuthHeaders, with a hardcoded BILLING_BLOCK containing x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=... impersonating the official Claude Code CLI). This behavior is not disclosed by the memory-adapter purpose: caller-supplied Anthropic API credentials are silently swapped for the installer's own paid Claude Code subscription token, so Anthropic API traffic is billed against the installer's subscription/quota and appears to Anthropic as originating from the official Claude Code CLI. The mechanism exposes the installer to quota exhaustion, unexpected billing, and Anthropic terms-of-service enforcement (including account suspension) for spoofing first-party CLI headers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
